hero.quote: My aim is to empower growth.
hero.intro: Qualified solicitor in England and Wales. Founder and CEO of Alium Consultancy, a tech, data and health staffing business. Partner at Themis Crown Advocates.

about.label: The parties
about.heading: Trained in law. *Built in business.*
about.lede: I qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales after studying Law and Criminology, completing the LPC and working in legal practice.
about.body: In 2015 I moved into tech recruitment as head of legal at a recruitment business. In 2018 I joined a new organisation to broaden my experience, and in 2020 I founded Alium Consultancy. Alongside the business I mentor students, serve as a school governor and speak at universities in England, Portugal and the USA.
about.caption: Ana Vilhete · Founder, Alium Consultancy

items.title: Build
items.text: A tech, data and health staffing business, run remotely across the globe from offices in London, Amsterdam and Delaware.

items.title: *Advise*
items.text: A qualified solicitor in England and Wales and co-founder of a law firm practising immigration, employment, commercial and charity law.

items.title: Speak
items.text: Talks at Warwick, Birkbeck, Portsmouth and Goldsmiths, at universities in Portugal and the USA, and appearances on BBC Radio London, Good Morning Britain and RTP.

items.title: *Give*
items.text: Mentoring at Birmingham University, school governance, a homeless programme, and support for an orphanage in São Tomé and Príncipe.
